_humanize_label (src/sqllens/_table_payload.py:44-66) returns name unchanged when it fails ^[a-z0-9]+(?:_[a-z0-9]+)*$ (line 61-62), so non-snake inputs pass through. For matching inputs, output is words joined by a space or a single word. Multi-word output contains a space, so the regex fails and it passes through unchanged. Single-word output: acronym gives uppercase (no regex match, passthrough); otherwise capitalize() yields an uppercase letter if the word starts with a letter (passthrough), or if it starts with a digit the word is unchanged (e.g. 2024, 2abc, 1st), a fixed point of the transform. Crafted inputs id -> ID -> ID; id_id -> 'ID ID' -> same; 2024 -> 2024 -> 2024. So idempotent for every input, and the docstring's claim matches the code.
